text: What to do if you are not getting enough attention from a girl? Let's say you've known her for a couple of weeks, you already slept together, it's not a serious relationship but you see each other from time to time. She works, she's busy, and now she says, let's not see each other too much, we need to slow things down. You start thinking, she told me she saw her ex 24-7, why is she pulling away from me? Here is why, it is not her, it is you. You've got too much free time, you're sitting around, waiting for her text, being fully available, while she's out working, living the life. So now, you are becoming the needy guy, and trust me, that's the fastest way to kill attraction. Here's what you do, fill up your schedule, build your life, go after your goals, go train, do your work, hang out with some friends, whatever makes you not bored and clingy. You shouldn't want to see her more than she wants to see you. Match her energy, or better yet, outpace it. You want her attention? Stop chasing it. Start becoming the guy who doesn't need it. That's when she starts chasing you.
